resources.string: Some sites prohibit cameras and electronic devices. View this guide only where devices are allowed. If cameras are not permitted here, you can still search every place by name.
TrueWay uses your camera for one photo
The photo stays on this device. It is used to match your image against places you have downloaded — it is never uploaded.
You can turn on camera access in system settings, or search for a place by name — scanning is optional.
Camera permission was permanently denied. Scanning is unavailable, but search, packs and saved places still work offline.
Compare with the alternatives below before deciding.
Your downloaded places don\'t include a tested recognition setup. Search by name instead — your history guide works fully offline.
Try retaking it where photography is allowed, or search by name instead.
Point at an official TrueWay plate. Only TrueWay codes are read — web links never open.
Signed by %1$s. Check the plate matches this place before continuing:
Wrong place on the plate? Tell staff on site, and search by name.
This code belongs to pack %1$s, which isn\'t on this device. No story was invented — search your installed places instead.
This code could not be verified
You can search the place by name instead.
This code has expired. Search the place by name instead.
Recognition is not installed yet. When the vision model and a region pack are added, this photo will be matched against your downloaded places — never against the internet.
No reliable match in your downloaded places
We couldn\'t reliably match this photo to your downloaded places. You can search by name or browse nearby places instead.
This area isn\'t in your offline pack yet
Browse installed content, or add a pack while you\'re connected. Search runs entirely on this device.
No installed place matches your search.
15-place Bihar demonstrator installed on this device: Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda summaries with sources. Search runs entirely offline — try “Mahabodhi”, “महाबोधि”, “Nalanda” or “Griddhakuta”.
Save a place or write a note from any history card. Saved notes stay on this device — no account, no upload.
Download a destination pack to read sourced history, search places and use the scanner offline. Each pack shows its size, languages and licences before you download.
Available after a pack is installed: opens a known stored card with no network.
TrueWay has no account and uploads nothing: photos, notes and scan results never leave this device.
Camera: explained at point of use. Location: optional and requested in context. Microphone: only for future voice search, if enabled.
English. Hindi content ships with the first region pack.
TrueWay feasibility build. Not legal, safety or archaeological certification. Sources and review dates appear on every history card.
Removes every photo captured by the scanner from this device.
Removes everything private from this device in one tap: scanner photos, journal notes, unlocked achievements and consent choices. This cannot be undone.
All private data deleted from this device
Test offline: open a stored card
Import a pack file from this device
Pack %1$s active: %2$d places, signed by %3$s. Your previous pack was kept until this one verified.
The pack failed integrity checks and wasn\'t activated. Your previous pack is safe.
Unknown publisher (%1$s). The pack wasn\'t activated.
A pack file was corrupt. The pack wasn\'t activated.
The pack contained an unsafe file path and was rejected: %1$s.
The pack contained a file not covered by its signed manifest and was rejected: %1$s.
This pack is older than your installed release and was refused.
This file isn\'t a TrueWay pack. Nothing was changed.
The pack is too large to stage safely on this device.
Not enough free storage to install this pack safely. Your previous pack is safe; free up space and try again.
The pack couldn\'t be installed (storage error). Your previous pack is safe.
Region pack removed. Bundled demonstrator is now active.
Download a region pack once. After that, search, stories, trails and scanning all work with no internet.
Airplane-mode ready: zero network calls in the read path.
Photograph a supported monument and TrueWay matches it on-device against your downloaded pack.
Unknown is a first-class answer — no match means no fabrication.
Scan official TrueWay plates. Every code is signature-checked before any story opens.
Web links never open from a scan. Only verified TrueWay codes work.
No account. Photos and notes never leave this device. Delete everything in one tap.
Your journal lives in a separate private file — deleting a pack never deletes notes.
Documented, interpretation, tradition and contested readings are labelled — never flattened into fact.
If evidence is weak, TrueWay says so instead of inventing history.
